displayDescription: A pen line pass builds a street, a transparent red wash opens over the landmark tower and dotted links connect the idea to the block.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: No reviewed preview recipes were supplied (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes; task lists an empty recipe set) and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json exists, so the preview demonstrates the base characteristic action: dark line pass, then a local wash over one landmark.

Watercolour is a procedural Canvas 2D approximation: seeded irregular masks, multiply blending, pooled pigment, granulation specks and a darker drying edge; no physical pigment flow or paper absorption is simulated.
Pen contours are seeded wobbling polylines with pressure-varied width and construction overshoot, not scanned ink.
Paper grain is a cached seeded noise texture on a stationary plane; background is a cool grey paper chosen for an overcast street, per the scene-dependent palette policy.
Blender was not used, per user instruction.
